content.text: The path is `/api/v1/<filename>`, but the download route is `/api/v1/files/:path`. The path is missing `files/`.

candidates.explanation: The stored and returned path is built as `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`. It leaves out the `files` segment. The download endpoint is `@Controller({path:'files', version:'1'})` with `@Get(':path')`, so it is served at `/api/v1/files/<filename>`. The returned link `/api/v1/<filename>` matches no route and gives 404, even though the file is on disk.

fix.description: Include the `files` segment in the generated path: `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/${file.filename}`.
